sources.title: partner-call.vtt · part 1
sources.text:
WEBVTT

00:00:04.000 --> 00:00:16.000
Maya (BD): Let's cover partner feedback for the week of 28 September. Luca, what are you hearing?

00:00:17.000 --> 00:00:33.000
Luca (Swisscom): Our partner managers are struggling to follow up with customers because the usage analytics arrive late. Fresher reporting would help. We'd also like to understand how fresh the data actually is.

00:00:34.000 --> 00:00:42.000
Maya (BD): Do we know whether that has caused lost revenue?

00:00:43.000 --> 00:00:50.000
Luca (Swisscom): No. We haven't measured any revenue loss. Please don't put a revenue number against this.

00:00:51.000 --> 00:01:08.000
Sara (Vodafone): On our side, we need a clearer onboarding checklist. It's hard to see which application providers have finished each step.

00:01:09.000 --> 00:01:18.000
Maya (BD): I'll bring that request to the engineering review. We haven't agreed a delivery date or committed engineering resources for it.
